title: review-verdict contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-78). The SHAPE of the review-verdict contract data the merge gate branches on. Shape is normative here; the verdict SEMANTICS + the revert test live in the gateway (ADR 0001, Decision 4). Coercion target for a malformed verdict is `needs-human` (never `pass`). FAFF-1146: each finding may additionally carry the OPTIONAL enrichment fields severity/disposition/source (enum-checked in the compute fn via violations — the spec-review-verdict lens/severity precedent) and refutation/model (free strings) — additive, never gating; a legacy {location_present, action_present}-only finding still validates because the enrichment fields are optional. The enum fields are plain strings here so an out-of-enum value is a soft violation (exit 1), never a schemaCheck fail-loud (exit 2). FAFF-1268: the collated evidence fields (finding_id, title, location, action, first_round, last_round, occurrences per finding; schema_version, rounds_total, round_history, adversarial_outcome, admitted_by at top level) pass through typed and optional; carried_id never passes through.
